description: Pixel art background: a wide shot of a late-night TV home shopping studio in red and black lacquer with gold trim, seen from the front corner of the raised stage at standing eye height, looking out at the audience at a slight three-quarter angle. In the lower left foreground, the edge of the empty stage. The rest of the image is the studio audience area, lower than the stage and facing the camera: many long rows of red and gold chairs on carpeted risers, each row a step higher than the one in front, running past the right and top edges, all empty. Pack the whole image with detail everywhere: stage, audience area, walls, ceiling and corners all full of set dressing, decoration and texture, a rich, glamorous, slightly eerie TV studio with real depth. Everything else is up to you. Rich lighting with clear shadows. Dense, highly detailed pixel art, crisp pixel clusters, selective dark outline, rich shading, no dithering, no blur. No people, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos.
